title: Opalite Health vs. Voyce
summary: AI vs. human interpretation for LEP patients: see how Opalite Health and Voyce differ on cost, scribing, and instant availability. September 2026
body_markdown:
###


Voyce is a technology-driven human-interpreter network delivering OPI and VRI, connecting care teams to credentialed human interpreters on demand. Opalite is an AI-native multilingual clinical workflow tool built by a physician-led team, combining real-time spoken interpretation, multilingual AI scribing, medical document translation, and Opalite Guardian safety controls. The core difference is the operating model, not simply speed or price.


###


No. Opalite is designed to work alongside human medical interpreting services. Human interpreters remain the right choice for ASL, emotionally sensitive conversations, high-risk encounters per organizational policy, and patient-preference requests. A hybrid approach, with Opalite covering spoken-language volume and a human service available for specific situations, is a common and practical configuration.


###


Without scribing, the provider charts the encounter after the visit. With Opalite's multilingual AI scribe, a draft note covering SOAP format, history of present illness, assessment and plan, and after-visit summaries is generated for provider review. The provider reviews, edits, and approves the note before it enters the medical record.


###


Full cost goes beyond per-minute rates. It includes silent-time billing during physical exams or pauses, staff coordination time, post-visit documentation burden, hardware management, and administrative overhead. Opalite contracts may exclude silent-time charges. Organizations have reported cost reductions of 50% or more compared with traditional per-minute services; actual results depend on current vendor rates and utilization patterns.


###


Yes, and this is a common approach. Many organizations run a hybrid model: Opalite covers spoken-language visit volume, while a human interpreter service handles ASL, high-risk encounters per organizational policy, or patient-preference requests. Opalite's escalation workflow supports transitioning to a human interpreter when needed within the same encounter.
